_label: ACROSS-PASS VARIANCE WITH RESUMED SESSION BOUNDARY
_NOT: This is NOT a single-session reproducibility result. Pass B was generated across two sessions. Any citation of these numbers must carry the label above; dropping the qualifier would claim a cleanliness the measurement does not have.
_NAMING: Distinct from calibration/noise_floor.v2.ai19-ollama.json, whose 'v2' is the SOURCE PACK version and whose numbers were measured against prompt set v1. Both files share a source pack; they do not share a prompt set. The 10 document:spreadsheet-text prompts differ between them, so the two floors must never be merged or read as a series.

_measured_from._sha256_note: truncated for readability; full digest in data/v2-pass-a/MANIFEST.json
truncated for readability; full digest in data/v2-pass-b/MANIFEST.json

pass_b_session_structure.resume_reason: Session 1 was stopped externally at trace 80 by a harness task-stop — not an infrastructure fault. The ai19 tunnel was still serving HTTP 200 and preflight still matched the int4 signature at the time of the stop. Session 2 resumed via scripts/run_expanded.sh, whose --resume appends only families absent from the output file.
pass_b_session_structure._plan_fingerprint_evidence: split_fingerprint ccb5ff683228c4c9 and template_sha256 114f55eb… are identical in both sessions and in pass A; all 9 pinned fields matched on comparison.
pass_b_session_structure._duplication_evidence: 260 traces, 260 distinct families, zero families appearing twice. Checked in pass_manifest.py rather than assumed from the runner's append semantics — a replayed chunk would have weighted every mean toward the replayed slice.
pass_b_session_structure._hash_evidence: All 260 traces in each pass re-render to the prompt_sha256 recorded at generation time (520/520, 0 mismatches), so both passes are observations of prompt set v2 and of nothing else.

mode_frequency_drift._max_case: prose:umum::0005 — disjoint answers, one mode in each pass and no overlap. An unchecked open-ended stratum.
mode_frequency_drift._why_reported: Mode-set membership alone would miss a prompt whose modes went 4:1 in one pass and 1:4 in the other. The mixture is what a training corpus inherits.

_coverage_note: constraints_ok covers 45/78 here against 48/78 under prompt set v1, because the revised spreadsheet prompts carry table_rows (a preservation ratio) instead of v1's must_contain (a pass/fail constraint). The stratum did not lose coverage; its evidence moved from constraints_ok to source_preserved.

table_fidelity._what: The gap prompt set v2 exists to close. document:spreadsheet-text now asks for the table back, so cell values are checkable.
table_fidelity.check: table_rows — a row counts only if all six of its cells appear together on one line
table_fidelity._validated: The check was shown to discriminate before being trusted: perfect copy 1.0, half the rows 0.5, two values rounded 0.5, a v1-style prose answer 0.0.
table_fidelity._result: The teacher reproduces the table intact at int4 on ai19, in both passes.

resume_boundary_analysis._question: Did the session boundary itself induce the answer variance?
resume_boundary_analysis._verdict: Consistent with chance. The post-boundary slice holds 69.2% of traces, so 5-of-6 falling there is close to what position-independence predicts. No evidence the resume caused the variance.
resume_boundary_analysis._LIMITATION: n=6 is also far too small to RULE OUT a boundary effect. This analysis cannot clear the resume, only decline to convict it. A single-session pass B is what would settle it.
resume_boundary_analysis._composition: 4 of the 6 differing prompts sit in the 5 unchecked open-ended prose strata, where more answer freedom is expected by construction.

_finding: Every across-pass metric delta is 0.0 at 21/26 strata coverage, including the table-fidelity check that prompt set v1 could not support. Answer text is less stable than the metrics: 6 of 78 prompts (7.7%) differ in answer set, the same 6 drifting in mode mixture, one of them completely. As under v1, the competing modes are acceptable answers, so textual variance did not move a metric.
_comparison_to_v1_is_NOT_licensed: Prompt set v1 reported 2/78 set differences and 11/78 mixture drift; this reports 6/78 and 6/78. Those numbers must NOT be read as a trend. The prompt sets differ, pass B here has a session boundary and v1's passes had their own interruption history, and n is small in both. Two numbers from two instruments are not a measurement of change.
_use: Cite as: across-pass variance with resumed session boundary, prompt set v2, 21/26 strata checked. Standing constraints: (1) do not describe this as single-session reproducibility; (2) do not merge with the prompt-set-v1 floor; (3) 5 open-ended prose strata still contribute to no constraint or preservation metric.
_corpus_status: synthetic_candidate. NOT training-ready. Promotion has not been approved and nothing in this file constitutes approval.
